# Critique and Improvements

The Awtsmoos reveals defects where confidence once stood; each critique becomes a clearer vessel.

1. Do not assume the existing two-minute pipeline fits a one-minute short.
2. Verify exact scene duration from authored timing.
3. Confirm spoken lines visibly change mouth geometry.
4. Confirm gaze is view-space and target-driven.
5. Confirm deterministic blink in preview and export.
6. Confirm neutral identity survives expression changes.
7. Confirm crossed arms remain locked through body and secondary motion.
8. Confirm pocket hand remains planted.
9. Confirm open palm, point, wave, and presenting silhouettes.
10. Confirm fingers read at 180×300.
11. Confirm toe, heel, and sole direction.
12. Confirm garments do not merge into limbs.
13. Confirm hair and garment sway use the evaluated clock.
14. Confirm camera cuts do not crop faces or captions.
15. Confirm title cards fit safe bounds.
16. Confirm serialization excludes caches and functions.
17. Confirm import restores authored identity and performance.
18. Confirm startup restoration uses the same project data.
19. Confirm preview and export share performance evaluation.
20. Confirm exported media is nontrivial and visually inspected.
21. Record dimensions and SHA-256 hashes.
22. Run git diff --check.
23. Audit touched headers, tabs, syntax, and line counts.
24. Re-read every touched file.
25. Compare plan against actual.
26. Challenge loading shells and blank renders.
27. Challenge legacy clocks.
28. Challenge unused state fields.
29. Challenge missing tests.
30. Close only with empty remaining work and NEXT_ACTION None.
